assumptions.farm: Solo, level 1, starter weapon equipped, default potions, 20 slots, common/uncommon equipment auto-sale on, production automation, no purchases, memory SQLite.
assumptions.phases: Counters attributed to the world/stage occupied during each simulation tick; small samples and pickup delays are not stable rates.
assumptions.milestones: First time the untouched wallet can fund all ranks up to the target; not a replay with purchases.
assumptions.bosses: Controlled fixtures at levels 8/10; same 1000 gold budget and supplied 20 dust/3 forge stones, default starting potions. Material costs are not equivalent. Fresh combat seed per paired scenario; actions can subsequently diverge.
assumptions.sustain: Select an unlocked healing skill, prioritize its slot and buy its ranks within budget. Unavailable when no healing skill is unlocked. Measures build plus upgrades, not just one coefficient.
assumptions.offline: Excluded from online farm rates; separate existing policy remains uncalibrated.
